text:
riley: heads-up we pushed prefix-KV prefetch + dynamic-batching-governor to canary (15%) at 09:10 PT. quick numbers below.

deploy-bot: deploy release/prefix-prefetch-dynamic-batcher -> canary-east (id: dpl_20260326_11)

riley: short prompts p50 ~200ms -> ~115ms, p95 ~470ms -> ~300ms, throughput +20%. sampled cost/token -17%. p99 for critical routes unchanged.

sam: awesome. where'd you run the sample? link?

riley: perf dash: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/prefetch/summary. sampling = 4k requests across peak and off-peak.

anita: any increase in evictions for long sessions? prefetch could be aggressive.

riley: prefetch uses LRU+soft-reserve, eviction rate stable. 16k-context tests show p95 +12ms worst-case.

perf-bot: snapshot: requests=4032, prefetch_hits=1550, avg_prefetch_latency=22ms, median_batch_size=4

sam: rollout plan? ramp cadence?

riley: going to 50% in 1h if no anomalies, full roll by EOD. monitoring: cache_hit_rate, batch_size_dist, gpu_util, retry_rate, p99 latency, GC pauses.

anita: please add a one-line for the release notes and a note for product about a console banner. also flag Dedicated customers; keep this infra-toggle for now.

riley: added release note draft and opened an Optimize ticket to recommend for compatible models.

sam: great job, team. let's also run the benchmark harness overnight against steady 100qps to validate cost extrapolation.

riley: agreed. ping this thread if you see any outliers. :rocket:
